Flowchart of the Solvay process. Ammoniacal brine and CO2 enter a Carbonating Tower. The mixture goes to a filter, separating solid NaHCO3 (which goes to a calciner to be heated into Na2CO3, recycling CO2) and liquid NH4Cl (which goes to an Ammonia Recovery unit where it reacts with Ca(OH)2 to release NH3, which is recycled back).
